rule.compare: a module compares the two only if the SAME face name appears in both arms
rule.gap: git show <rev>:<face> against the bytes on disk, at this moment; git is read, never written
rule.mode: the E401 arm resolves the callable; the module's own load literals say whether a working-tree arm exists at all
rule.no_rewrite: no reader was edited; the fix stays a separate card
